=== [D1] Fix 2: "Convert to Effect.fnUntraced" ===

--- file:///.src/effectFnOpportunity_nestedInitializer.ts ---
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const define: <A>(options: {
  readonly name: string
  readonly decode: (value: string) => Effect.Effect<A>
}) => A

export const configuration = define({
  name: "workspace",
  decode: Effect.fnUntraced(function*(value) {
      const text = yield* Effect.succeed(value)
      return text.length
    }),
})

interface Definition<A> {
  readonly read: (path: string) => Effect.Effect<A>
}

export const make = <A>(value: A): Definition<A> => ({
  read: (path) =>
    Effect.gen(function*() {
      yield* Effect.log(path)
      return value
    }),
})

import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const define: <A>(options: {
  readonly name: string
  readonly decode: (value: string) => Effect.Effect<A>
}) => A

export const configuration = define({
  name: "workspace",
  decode: (value) =>
    Effect.gen(function*() {
      const text = yield* Effect.succeed(value)
      return text.length
    }),
})

interface Definition<A> {
  readonly read: (path: string) => Effect.Effect<A>
}

export const make = <A>(value: A): Definition<A> => ({
  read: Effect.fn("read")(function*(path) {
      yield* Effect.log(path)
      return value
    }),
})
